notes.title: The World Grows: Avalon’s Summer Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,
It’s time for another dev update before we all head out for some well-earned summer adventures. The Vikings are dusting off their longships, the Dragon Raiders are soaring off into the skies, and the rest of you — well, there’s always a sturdy horse… or an extremely confused sheep ready to carry you to your favorite holiday spot. 🐑

Let’s dive into what the team has been working on over the past two months!



We know RPG players love two things: getting lost in mysterious places and leveling up while doing it. So we’ve carved out a few new cave systems — one echoing the Egyptian roots of Templar lore, and another steeped in Inquisitor fire magic.

They’ll be hard to find and even harder to survive — so bring a torch, sharpen your blade, and maybe kiss your gear goodbye just in case. 
Here’s a small sneak peek:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/ca0cf0099f59826ae8268495e50ec3105d68240c.png"]

Expect riddles and ghosts. Expect fire spiders, lava traps, and the occasional scream that may or may not be yours. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/3618707f0f6c9b1e211b8fe6e853181fbddf9bd6.png"]



Oh — and let’s not forget the new werewolf boss location we’ve been howling over. 🐺

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/4635e89aaf0a08c0bf65fe9855f708b195b321ab.png"]

Let’s just say… May was definitely the month of world expansion — and your enemies didn’t take any vacation.



June, on the other hand, was all about preparing the stage. We’ve scattered multiple new “Robin of In-the-Hood” style camps across the wilderness — perfect for ambushes, banter, or just stealing apples. 🍎

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/b716acc2e064e73f880d206b8a916ef1e36372a8.png"]



We also placed several Templar outposts, which will soon serve as key quest hubs, lore points, and occasional last-chance respawn locations (you’ve been warned).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/da732c7f18cceb97fcf6f09b282715e69eab326f.png"]



But before we dive (pun intended) into the long list of technical improvements, we’ve got something a little more... scaly to show you. 

Meet the early-stage version of the Druidic Water Dragon — yes, it dives through rivers, soars through the skies, and poisons entire areas just because it can. And yes... only Druids can tame it. So if you're not one yet, you might want to rethink your career path.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/cc35b70ac7e5f5c020982ccbc9a6f7192389d29e.png"]


Avalon MMO now features 72 unique enemy types — a number that places us alongside genre leaders like Guild Wars, Final Fantasy XIV, Elder Scrolls Online, and Black Desert in terms of variety.


Not bad for an indie studio with a dream (and too much coffee). Some of these enemies will challenge your every move. Others… like the one ghoul who keeps flinging himself off cliffs every few minutes — well, let’s just say he’s not the brains of the undead operation.




Bug Squashing, Bread Baking, and Beast Taming – Just Another Month  in Avalon: 

[hr][/hr]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements
Altar Quests: Now work properly; all altars on the map are fully functional.

Character Bug: Fixed bug where characters could interact with themselves.

Inventory UI: Item names and availability now properly centered.

Vendors: Show correct owner names.

Portals: “Unclaim” button only shows if you have access; interaction is now instant.

Doors, Gates & Signs: Respond immediately when interacted with.

Mills & Harbor Mansion: Can now be interacted with; ownership bugs fixed.

Duplicate Rewards: Fixed issue causing players to receive the same reward twice.

Lady & Son Quest: Fully restored; son's location and animations updated.

Quest Text: Multiple quests have updated or corrected dialogue.

Quest Rewards: Several quests have rebalanced or corrected rewards.

Backend Fixes: Improved data loading, redirectors, and internal cleanup.
[hr][/hr]🐴 Mounts
Collision Fixes: Mounts won’t spawn inside walls or strange locations.

Spawn Failures: If spawning fails, a message shows and the mount is unequipped.

Dismount Fixes: No more falling through the floor; dismounts now use valid locations.
[hr][/hr]🧟 Enemies & AI
Ghouls: No more sliding punches; added impact FX.

Troll (WIP): Continued tuning and improvements.

Enemy Movement: Fixed bugs where enemies would get stuck, stop chasing, or become unkillable.

Combat Logic: More reliable enemy behavior during combat and patrol.
[hr][/hr]⚔️ Raids
Tracking: Enemy/wave/timing stats now track accurately.

UI: Raid info displays and updates correctly in real time.
[hr][/hr]🍞 New Items
Yeast – Needed to bake bread.

Honey Milk – Ingredient for honey bread.

Strawberries – Used in berry bread.
[hr][/hr]🧩 Other Improvements
Interaction Accuracy: More precise targeting when interacting with world objects.

UI Layouts: Cleaner visuals for profile and portal windows.

Data Cleanup: Removed old/unused logic for improved performance.
[hr][/hr]



Make sure you don’t miss any news by following us on social media!Wishlist our beautiful game now !

notes.title: New Horizons Await: "Avalon - Rise of The Templars" Development Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/2d0c3c8e02e5838ed642f91bf1314ee85ca55f91.png

Chaos Fades. Magic Awakens. Templars, Vikings, Inquisitors, and Druids of Avalon… Prepare for Glory!

Hello, Avalon adventurers! Updating you on three years of development is no small task, but let’s dive in! We’re rolling out details on features added over the past year and fresh additions landing in recent patches. First up: our world map updates. Avalon isn’t just a gritty medieval realm—it’s a vibrant tapestry of diverse regions, like the lush Druidic Hunting Grounds, teeming with life and color. We’ve prioritized a visually striking world to keep your journeys vivid, though dungeons remain suitably moody for that classic crypt-crawling vibe.

Thanks to our technical MMO test group requests, we’ve added a third-person camera with optional far-out zoom to track teammates in raids, plus a first-person view for inspecting artifacts and hidden secrets. 


 The first initial village in genesis map "Dragon Heart" 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/159c9e588864a3c0b1de513ee19255d7123bb6f9.png

The 3th Person Far Zoom Out  Camera Update showcasing Attila Harbor - Genesis Island
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/6fd1324769db61b0e3233ddcec19fa67ce2a271d.png


Our homes received external and interior updates, new ownership, game save, respawn, and inventory expansion systems in your home. Should you choose to own one:) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/cc09af0e15e9ed8e181360fdf5ed6920dfffdf22.png

Customize homes with clan banners, save your spawn point and heal your character at your own bed.

Small homes can be equally beautiful.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/8ce0834e847ed6cf7bad0f017af00417a1503a58.png

Large Homes = Large inventory  storage + daily resource and ammo spawn.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/0810d7c92023c0913c06fa626b987e7ea249f12a.jpg

Home interior updates include new paintings, fresh carpets, and a cozy firepit to cook your favorite meals. Transform your abode into a welcoming haven!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/d7b9e3f6b320735e30cb5bed6afb0d816baa56a2.jpg




Why Own a Home in Avalon?

A great question — and we've prepared some creative (and sometimes mischievous) reasons you'll want your own cozy corner of the world:


Extra Storage, Extra Adventure: Homes come with chest storage — the bigger the home, the bigger your hoard of loot can be!

Home-Cooked Victories: Cook custom recipes right at your personal stove. Nothing beats a hot meal before battle.

Save Your Journey: Set your home bed as your personal respawn point — no more wandering the wilds lost after a tough fight.

Daily Surprise Baskets: Once per day, a basket of rare goodies will appear in your home — from rare resources to a handful of coins or even bonus ammo!

Harvest from Home: Farms drop daily food items, and some will yield full harvests of grain perfect for bread baking (and maybe bribing hungry allies).

Host (Almost) Everyone: Invite up to 4 friends into your home to rest, regroup, and dodge those terrifying night monsters.

 (Your private chests are off-limits — but shared resource bins might not be so safe!)*



Our shipwreck landing zone, where new players begin their adventures in the tavern tutorial map, marks the Templar ship’s crash site from our lore. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/b0025831b8b926b3f32e2ed5f8161c57c0a59040.png

 We’ve also refined our winter foliage setup—still a work in progress, but growing more stunning with each update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/b6731ff523e0a7551d5581df84d31cf5b3b34b7b.png

We’ve updated our quest journal menu with quest progress, tracking, waypoints to guide you to your next destination, reward displays, and separate folders for completed and in-progress quests. When designing Avalon’s UI layout, we prioritize clean, easily readable, simplified, and intuitive interfaces for quests, inventory, NPC interactions, and merchants. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/e2d5c35a52d96cf9199daf9ab5b2e29ddb64ef24.png

PVP in Avalon: Pick Your Battles
PVP in Avalon is fully optional — you can choose to enable duels at any time, or live your life peacefully, never worrying about getting stabbed in the back by a “friend.”

...But let’s be honest. There’s always that one guy.
You know, the one who bailed on your raid when the boss had 2% health left.
Maybe — just maybe — you’ll bump into him one day... on a lonely bridge...
A little friendly challenge. Just you, him... and gravity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/534306711ee917b14ae245207ebaaf737a22de52.png

Oh, and if you're feeling extra feisty, we also have PVP Arenas where teams (or just brave souls) can challenge each other for glory, bragging rights, and rare gear.

Choose peace... or vengeance. It’s totally up to you.


Grinding Areas for the Brave (and the Slightly Unhinged)
Every great fantasy world needs a place where you can shut off your brain, grab your sword, and just start smashing things until your XP bar begs for mercy.

In Avalon, we get it.
That’s why we’ve crafted sprawling graveyards and crumbling tombs, perfect for those of you who prefer leveling up the old-fashioned way — by slaughtering skeletons, bashing ghouls, and smashing anything that looks remotely cursed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307987/100f18b47c1d12060ea00fa258b34d3caefd7499.jpg

Sometimes you don’t need a quest.
Sometimes you just need an axe, a dark corner of the map, and a lot of pent-up rage.

Come embrace the darker side of your soul — and farm some glorious loot while you're at it.
